cards.gate: Night veils Lanka. Hanuman reaches the sea gate.
cards.city: Torches light the streets. Hanuman searches for Sita.
cards.bridges: Across the moat, the palace waits.
cards.stairway: The great stairway rises toward Ravana's palace.
cards.court: Hanuman slips into the palace court.
cards.halls: He searches the pillared halls. No sign of Sita.
cards.grove: Moonlight falls on the Ashoka grove.
cards.throne: Bound by choice, Hanuman stands before Ravana.
cards.fire: Hanuman grows vast. His burning tail sets Lanka ablaze.
cards.end: Lanka burns behind him. He carries Sita's hope to Rama.

lankini_challenge.line: Halt, little monkey. Who dares enter Lanka?
I have crossed the sea on my lord's errand.
I guard this city. None may pass me.
Let me pass. I seek no quarrel with you.

lankini_yields.line: A monkey has struck me down.
The prophecy said this would herald Lanka's fall.
Go in. I will not bar your way.

grove_sita.line: Hidden in the branches, Hanuman sees Sita below.
She grieves, yet her faith in Rama holds.
He descends and bows before her.
Mother, I am Hanuman, Rama's messenger.
Ravana wears many forms. How can I trust you?
Rama sent this ring as a sign. Please take it.
His ring. Tell me, is my lord well?
He is safe, but he grieves for you.
Take my hair jewel. Rama will know it.
I will place it in his hands.
Bring Rama soon. Ravana gives me little time.

grove_wreck.line: Before I go, Ravana must know whom I serve.
Let Lanka see the strength of Rama's servant.

grove_bound.line: The monkey has ceased to fight. Bind him.
I will bear these bonds to reach Ravana.
I must speak to him face to face.

throne.line: Who are you to lay waste to my grove?
I am Hanuman, a messenger of Rama.
You speak his name before the lord of Lanka?
I came to find Sita. I have seen her grief.
Return her to Rama. There is still time.
You would command me in my own court?
I ask you to spare your people this war.
Even your might cannot shield you from Rama.
Enough. Guards, wrap his tail in cloth and oil.
Set it alight. Lead him through the streets.

ignite.line: Sita prays. The fire leaves Hanuman unharmed.
Hanuman breaks free of his bonds.

ending.line: Sita is safe in the grove, untouched by the fire.
Hanuman leaps across the sea, back toward Rama.

grove_ravana.line: Hidden in the branches, Hanuman watches the moonlit Ashoka grove.
Ravana comes with his attendants. Sita sits on the ground.
Yield to me, Sita. All my kingdom shall be yours.
Without fear, Sita sets a blade of grass between them.
I am Rama's wife. Your riches mean nothing to me.
Rama will come. Your power cannot shield you from him.
You have two months to yield, or you shall die.
Ravana turns in anger and leaves the grove.
He has gone. Now I must find a way to speak to Sita.

court_arrival.line: Bound, Hanuman is led into Ravana's great court.
The hall of gold is filled with Lanka's lords and warriors.

roar.line: Grown vast, Hanuman stands at the heart of the burning city.
His mighty roar fills Lanka with the name of Rama.
